name: npv_level_annuity_outlay
question_template: A project requires an initial outlay of USD {I0} at time zero and returns a level cash flow of USD {C} at the end of each year for {N} years, with no salvage. The annual discount rate is r={R} percent, compounded annually. Compute the NPV as the present value of the level cash flows minus the initial outlay. Use exact arithmetic throughout.

slots.description: Exact present value factor of the level annuity.
Present value of all level cash flows.

program:
def solve():
    I0 = P["I0"]
    C = P["C"]
    n = P["N"]
    r = Fraction(P["R"]) / 100
    if r <= 0:
        raise ValueError("rate must be positive")
    growth = (1 + r) ** n
    af = (1 - 1 / growth) / r
    pv = C * af
    npv = pv - I0
    return {"final": npv, "annuity_factor_trace": af, "annuity_pv_trace": pv}
